session_summary: As the Explorer & Collector persona, I traversed Whispering Fen, collected route rewards, and successfully purchased the Trail Cap cosmetic from the market, ending with 88 coins. The current world state highlights a featured Moss Trail with a Moss Token Rumor content pack.

observations.evidence: Completed Whispering Fen route and earned +25 coins, noting collectibles Mooncap and Fen Pearl listed in world state.
observations.recommendation: Add a dedicated collection ledger in the UI so players can easily track which unique route collectibles (like Mooncap and Fen Pearl) they have acquired.

observations.evidence: Successfully purchased and equipped Trail Cap for 45 coins, leaving 88 coins.
observations.recommendation: Expand the cosmetic lineup or rotate stock to give collectors more long-term cosmetic purchase goals.

observations.evidence: World state features the Moss Trail with a 'Moss Token Rumor' collectible rumor.
observations.recommendation: Incorporate brief environmental lore text pop-ups when discovering rumored items to enhance the exploration reward.

feature_requests.title: Route Discovery Log and Collector Milestones
feature_requests.player_value: Provides a clear overview of undiscovered secrets, collectibles, and cosmetics across all routes.
feature_requests.rationale: As an Explorer & Collector, having an in-game tracking mechanism for route discoveries heavily drives replayability and engagement.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: A menu section displaying collected items per route and rewarding completionists with unique cosmetic tints.

keep: Rewarding route completion with coin payouts that immediately feed into cosmetic purchases like the Trail Cap.
The thematic route design and clear collectible listings provided in the world state metadata.
Content packs like the Moss Token Rumor that hint at special items on featured routes.
focus: route variety, discoveries, collectibles, cosmetics, reasons to revisit routes
